title: Corrigir integridade da sequência persistida Atlas

original_finding.trigger: Persist a syntactically valid existing Atlas event with its seq changed to another nonnegative safe integer. During read(), event.seq is checked for type/range but replaced with expected.seq for digest comparison; modified seq remains accepted and the returned ordered log sorts by the attacker/corruption-controlled value. Multiple events may share the same seq or be reordered without rejection.
original_finding.root_cause: The read integrity predicate checks digest of {...event,seq:expected.seq}, discarding the stored event ordinal before comparison, while appends write strictly increasing ordinals.
original_finding.criticality: Fail-closed integrity invariant of the durable event journal. This does not assert an external arbitrary attacker can edit the protected store.

proof.observed: Validation accepts altered seq except unsafe/negative, and reorder/duplicate never checked before respawnFromRecord.
proof.not_proven: No corruption injection, restarts, fresh process, or real scanner run by 208.

owner.writer: WP10.T07 Atlas boundary/storage authority, active lease to confirm; 198/PR183 proof consumer

original_finding.requested_fix: Validate persisted ordinal uniqueness, expected monotonic append order and consistency without comparing legitimate event.seq to constant versioned([record]).seq. Preserve scanner and existing engine.

recheck.trigger: 189 integrates owner correction in accepted same-C source; deduplicate against 198 AM05 requests
recheck.minimal_proof: At least two committed task/project records: untouched journal reload/restart positive; mutated seq duplicate/out-of-order/tampered ordinal fails closed with zero disclosed records and zero committed append; next append after clean restart monotonic; scanner clean/hit/unavailable remain independent.

Cobrir pelo menosdoisrecordscommitted, leitura/reabertura positiva, nextappend apósrestartmonotônico; duplicate/outoforder/tamperedordinal devem falhar semvazarrecords oucommitarappend.
Usar store/persistência real e source de Atlas existente; preservar scanner, C08/C09, idempotência, callbacks e engine. Nenhum reset/migração destrutiva/sort que esconda corrupção.
Entregar fix completo e regressões, request214 deduplicável com198, sourceblobs e causalrecheck208.
